name: OmaVideos
author: bhanu
description: Paste a YouTube, Reddit, X, or any video URL to grab it at the best quality with audio.

barWidget.description: A download arrow in the bar. Click it, paste any video URL (YouTube, Reddit, X, Vimeo, Twitch…), and it lands in your omavideos folder at the best quality with audio — with optional quality caps, playlist item picking, time-range trimming, and audio-only extraction.

schema.label: Quality cap
schema.description: Best available, or capped at this resolution.

schema.label: Audio only
schema.description: Extract the best audio track as high-bitrate m4a instead of video.

schema.label: Trim time range
schema.description: Download only the given slice of the video.

schema.label: YouTube client
schema.description: Player client YouTube uses; web_embedded is the most reliable default.
